headline: Kurjibhai Premjibhai Rupareliya files substantial acquisition disclosure in Aqylon Nexus Limited
sum: Kurjibhai Premjibhai Rupareliya has filed a Regulation 31(4) takeover disclosure with the NSE for Aqylon Nexus Limited, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI takeover rules.
detail: Kurjibhai Premjibhai Rupareliya has submitted to the NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is typically filed by an acquiror upon crossing 5% of voting share capital or when acquiring shares that result in aggregated holdings moving from below 5% to 5% or above, or in incremental tranches of 2%. The filing triggers a 4-trading-day public announcement window for the target company under Regulation 37 and may lead to a mandatory open offer if thresholds are crossed.
